concept: position-bias-aware ranking via time_ms ordering feature
hypothesis: Checkpoint #4 (valid=0.6044) added a coarse 10-decile position_bucket field derived from within-user-day time_ms rank. Since eval lists are short (~7 impressions/user), the 10-bucket decile discretization is too coarse to distinguish adjacent positions within a user's short list, collapsing most of a user's rows into the same 1-2 buckets and losing signal. Using finer-grained buckets (quintile-of-length-relative rank replaced with raw small-integer position index capped at a max, i.e. absolute rank 0..9 rather than fraction-of-list decile) will let position bias be learned at the actual granularity these short lists exhibit, further improving valid primary beyond 0.6044.
